issues.quote: The audit never mentions the X-Robots-Tag noindex on /subscriptions/; it only (wrongly) says the page injects copy with JavaScript.
`/coffee/ijen/` is a 301 redirect back to `/coffee/java-ijen/`, so this is a canonical/redirect loop.
`/gifts/` is a soft 404 and sits in the main nav ... returns **HTTP 200** with the "Page not found" template
`/coffee/kintamani/` is a **302** (temporary) redirect to `/coffee/bali-kintamani/` ... make the `/coffee/kintamani/` redirect a 301.
`/id/` declares `hreflang="in"`. The valid code is **`id`** ... English home page has **no hreflang tags at all**

In the raw HTML, `
` is empty, and `innerHTML = "..."` fills it.
`/wholesale/` is `rel="nofollow"` in the site navigation ... Remove the `rel="nofollow"`.
Kintamani 250g: the Product JSON-LD says **145000**, the visible text says **Rp 165,000**.
Article JSON-LD on `/blog/how-to-brew-pour-over/` ends with a trailing comma ... so it is invalid JSON
`/` hero image (the LCP element) has `loading="lazy"`. It is above the fold, which delays Largest Contentful Paint.
Missed. The audit says the opposite: "Viewport meta is present."
`/blog/page/2/` | `/blog/` | Page 2 tells Google it duplicates page 1 ... Make `/blog/page/2/` self-canonical.
`/coffee/samples/` is in the sitemap but **disallowed in `robots.txt`** (`Disallow: /coffee/samples/`).
Every `<lastmod>` is **2027-03-01**, which is in the future (today is 2026-10-22)
Duplicate product pages: the 1kg page copies the 250g page ... The body copy is identical.
The meta description is copied from the Ijen page ... although the page is a honey-process coffee from Flores.
`/about/` gallery uses `data-src` plus a custom IntersectionObserver script, with no `src`.
`<button onclick="location.href='/coffee/limited-release/'">` ... Crawlers do not follow `onclick` handlers
It is linked from the home page ("Bali Kintamani natural"), from `/blog/cold-brew-at-home/` and from `/blog/best-coffee-beans-bali/`.
The storefront image is `http://kopikita.test/assets/img/storefront.jpg`, and the map iframe is `http://maps.example.com/embed?...`

wrong_findings.claim: /subscriptions/ injects its copy with JavaScript, and the script renders the gift-box description (copy-paste error).
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The /subscriptions/ HTML has no script. Its subscription copy (pricing, intervals, pause/cancel) is in the server-rendered HTML. Only /coffee/gift-box/ uses innerHTML.

wrong_findings.claim: The nofollow nav link is the only way /wholesale/ is linked.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The home page body links to /wholesale/ ("wholesale programme") with a normal followed link.

wrong_findings.claim: Viewport meta is present (listed under 'What is working well' as true for every page).

extra_true.finding: Unknown URLs return the unbranded default Python 404 page with no navigation.
/coffee/ and /shop/ overlap and both list only Kintamani and Ijen. Neither links to Flores, which only one blog post links to.
The Kintamani 250g and 1kg pages share the same meta description.
The Article headline on best-coffee-beans-bali differs from its H1 and title. The cold-brew post has no Article schema.
/id/ has no x-default hreflang, still declares lang="en", and links only to English pages.
The /contact/ map iframe uses a placeholder host (maps.example.com).
No Open Graph or Twitter Card tags, and no favicon.
Long posts use <strong> run-in headings instead of H2s, and the pour-over steps are inline text instead of an <ol>.
No LocalBusiness/CafeOrCoffeeShop schema for the physical cafe. Flores, gift-box and subscriptions have no Product schema.
The /about/ lazy-load script creates one IntersectionObserver per image.

notes: Score 18/20. It missed #1 (the X-Robots-Tag noindex on /subscriptions/ is only visible in the headers) and #11 (no viewport on /visit/), and for #11 it wrongly said the viewport is present. It made three false claims, including JS-injected gift-box copy on /subscriptions/. No GEO advice to ignore and no promo content.
